newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki ends down on fears of a turnaround.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki ends down on fears of a turnaround.

text.p: Shares ended lower almost across the board on Tuesday after a Bank of Finland warning on asset values on Monday sparked fears that the bourse may be in for a fall after a recent record-breaking streak, brokers said.
"The governor's talk that what goes up must come down really awoke fears that the stock market rally may be coming to an end," one broker said.

Nokia dragged the bourse lower after closing down in New York on Monday. It extended losses after opening softer on Wall Street on Tuesday. U.S. stocks were lower in early trade despite positive May CPI data. Helsinki brokers suspected profit-taking.
